g.text: EXP-032: retraining response across deletion budgets
Current recovery run only | Retrain only | No GU or Original / 0% endpoint

Four fixed display selectors; all 10 are in the CSV. Lines join measured budgets; panel y-scales differ. Stored f1 = accuracy / micro-F1.
